Across the seas of mists they light the path to home, to glorious Yvara wherein the Majjvara dwells.''"<br />"''Gunthar&hellip; what in blazes did you just say?''"<br />"''Captain, I am home.|[[Kaiya Adrimetrum]] and [[Gunthar]]|<ref name="TKR">''[[The Kathol Rift]]''</ref>}}
The '''Horns of Waryl''' was a [[Constellation/Legends|constellation]] visible from the [[Yvara system/Legends|Yvara system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located deep within the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] in an area known as the [[Blue Swirl]]. It was comprised of three [[Star/Legends|stars]] that formed an inverted pyramid. This constellation was considered a welcome sight to those returning home to [[Yvara]].
